verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation on per-channel/keyword/schedule notification preferences (e.g., mute channels, keyword alerts, do-not-disturb scheduling) — Slack's actual notification settings are not represented anywhere in this pack, only unrelated AI, workflow, MCP, and integration docs. Missing for 10: any mention of notification preferences, keyword alerts, per-channel mute/schedule controls, or admin-level notification policy tools.
